content: If you remember that you missed a dose, take it as soon as possible. However, if it is close to the time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Storage Instructions: Store the medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local disposal guidelines. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not intended to replace individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health requirements.
